project: Eightfold — Atlas v3 (Quarry broad expansion): sealed delta predictions
note: Sealed BEFORE any atlas_v3 cell is drafted (sealed-before-measured). Atlas v3 broadly expands the frozen 118-row canon with the screened Quarry supply (~227 candidates + un-mined source remainders) across ALL columns; 300-450 rows is an OUTCOME, not a target (owner ruling, broad expansion supersedes Quarry K4 expand-narrow). Every statistical bet below is OUT-OF-SAMPLE: scored on the v3-NEW-only rows (the added population alone), NOT the full v3 roster which the carried-over 118 would dominate. Three-population reporting (v2 / v3-full / v3-new) in every table. Locking rule: a changed bet is a new prereg version (prereg_v10.json), never an in-place edit.
framing_honesty: Expansion sharpens canon statistics (precision); it does NOT de-bias the canon (F1 — more famous rows deepen the canon bias). These bets test whether the v2 STRUCTURE reproduces OUT-OF-SAMPLE on a broader, provenance-tagged roster, and decompose any shift by source funnel. A confirmed bet is precision; a miss is a decomposable finding, not a failure.

populations.v3_new: the admitted v3 rows ONLY — the out-of-sample test set every bet is scored on

B1_gradient_robustness.prediction: The approximation<->parameterized both-real Cramer's V computed on v3-NEW-only lands inside v2's 95% bootstrap CI — the new roster INDEPENDENTLY reproduces the hardness gradient.
B1_gradient_robustness.decision_rule: Compute v2's 95% bootstrap CI of the both-real approx<->param V (B=10000 resamples over v2's both-real rows; v2 point = 0.7293 full / 0.6807 dedup-114, from crucible_results.json S2). BET HOLDS iff the v3-new-only both-real V falls inside that CI. Movement OUTSIDE the CI => the v2 gradient was partly roster-composition, decomposed by funnel (B6) — a finding either way, stated in advance as acceptable.
B1_gradient_robustness.measured_in: crucible._both_real_v on the v3_new subset; manifest claim canon.gradient.v3new

B2_incompressibility.prediction: Effective dimensionality k* = 1 on v3-new-only (held-out LCM 1-SE estimator, the v7 battery).
B2_incompressibility.decision_rule: factors.factors_verdict on v3_new. k*=1 AGREES with the v7/v2 primary. k*>=2 (a real basis emerging at larger n) would be the program's BIGGEST POSITIVE SURPRISE and is genuinely possible — stated as uncertain, reported at size; it does not retroactively touch the v2 k*=1 banked verdict.

B3_NPI_calibration.prediction: The NPI-candidate decision row grows ONLY by candidates admitted AS NPI-candidates; no CSP-shaped / dichotomy-decidable (NPC) row is mis-slotted into NPI.
B3_NPI_calibration.decision_rule: Enumerate every v3_new row with decision=NPI-candidate; each must be an independently literature-attested NP-intermediate candidate (graph-isomorphism / factoring class), not a mis-typed NPC. A single CSP-shaped NPI row = calibration FAIL, reported. (A pure calibration bet — guards against the expansion inflating the thin NPI row with mis-types.)

B4_occupancy.prediction: The decision=PH-complete x parameterized=FPT occupancy cell stays inhabited (abstract-argumentation, skeptical/preferred Pi_2^p x FPT-by-treewidth, verified at Quarry K3); the remaining v2 gap-list cells' fates are enumerated per-cell as sealed bets BEFORE the rerun.
B4_occupancy.decision_rule: For each of the 123 v2 gap-list cells (a3_structure.json H3_forbidden_and_gaps): a sealed 'inhabited by a v3 row / still empty' call, committed per-cell in the V4 findings appendix. The PH-complete x FPT cell is pre-called INHABITED. Scored at V4 against the v3 occupancy grid; theorem-forbidden cells must stay empty (a v3 row there = data-violates-theorem bug).

B5_folklore_gap_at_scale.prediction: The fraction of counting cells carrying a per-problem PUBLISHED #P-hardness proof does not materially improve at scale — the field's gap, not our effort's.
B5_folklore_gap_at_scale.decision_rule: Compute the per-problem-cited fraction of real counting cells on v3_new; BET HOLDS iff within noise of v2's counting citation density (~37/118 published, per counting-folklore-gap.md). Expected: many v3 counting cells resolve to open under the F-1 per-problem bar, holding the gap. A large improvement would falsify the folklore-gap finding (a welcome surprise, reported).

B6_funnel_homogeneity.prediction: The gradient/structure signal is HOMOGENEOUS across the six source funnels — no single funnel (rn / ck / ghr / df / dh / su) drives the v3 structure.
B6_funnel_homogeneity.decision_rule: Compute the both-real approx<->param V within each funnel's v3_new rows; BET HOLDS iff every per-funnel V is within the 95% bootstrap band of the pooled v3_new V (no funnel outlier). A funnel outlier => that funnel's supply is structurally distinct (a decomposable finding), NOT a bad program. This is the de-confounding check the provenance-per-row rule (spec section 4) exists to enable.

kill_thresholds.funnel_poisoning_V2: any source funnel whose sampled or full owner-confirm shows error > 15% is quarantined (its rows drop to open-heavy or are excluded, documented); the wave continues without it. Scope stays broad; a bad funnel is not a bad program.
kill_thresholds.validator_integrity_V1_V3: v2 byte-identity is inviolable; any tooling change that touches atlas.jsonl or atlas_v2.jsonl halts the milestone.
kill_thresholds.box: drafting + battery ~= 25-35 h paired (drafting compresses; the battery is harness reruns). OWNER confirm sittings are explicitly UNBOUNDED and UNESTIMATED — the real cost, measured at wave 1's first sitting and reported honestly rather than guessed. No compute beyond laptop.
